label: TP
reason: The CodeQL report correctly identifies two XSS vectors where untrusted header names/values are concatenated directly into HTML output via PrintWriter. The data flows from request headers (source) through concatenation operators (+) to response.getWriter().println() sinks without any sanitization or context-aware escaping.

evidence.note: Unsanitized user input from request headers is concatenated into HTML response output, enabling XSS attacks.
